title: The well and Israel’s song
english: On the well and its song: the reading of the well where Israel sang overflows with mysteries. [[This is the well of which the Lord said to Moses, Gather the people, and I will give them water to drink >> Bible:Numbers 21:16-17]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XI; well and song CLOSEOUT.

title: Gather the people to drink
english: Bare history is not enough — the people would come to drink of themselves. The command to gather them sends us to spiritual sense: draw the water of God’s word.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XI; well and song CLOSEOUT.

title: Coming into Jeshurun / power over the enemy
english: If we come into Jeshurun — that is, if we keep the Lord’s commands — [[God will crush Satan under your feet >> Bible:Romans 16:20]], and we receive [[power to tread on serpents and scorpions >> Bible:Luke 10:19]]. To whom be glory and dominion forever. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
